command.summary: Create a web app. The web app's name must be able to produce a unique FQDN as AppName.azurewebsites.net. This command creates the web app resource but does not deploy code. Use 'az webapp list-runtimes' to see available runtimes. Suggested next steps after creation: - Deploy your code: az webapp deploy -g MyResourceGroup -n MyAppName --src-path app.zip - For Linux apps loading large models or dependencies at startup, increase the container start time limit (default 230s, max 1800s): az webapp config appsettings set -g MyResourceGroup -n MyAppName --settings WEBSITES_CONTAINER_START_TIME_LIMIT=1800.

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: Name of the new web app. Web app name can contain only allow alphanumeric characters and hyphens, it cannot start or end in a hyphen, and must be less than 64 characters.

parameters.name: --plan
parameters.help: Name or resource id of the app service plan. Use 'appservice plan create' to get one.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --acr-identity
parameters.help: Accept system or user assigned identity which will be set for acr image pull. Use '[system]' to refer system assigned identity, or a resource id to refer user assigned identity.

parameters.name: --acr-use-identity
parameters.help: Enable or disable pull image from acr use managed identity.

parameters.name: --assign-identity
parameters.help: Accept system or user assigned identities separated by spaces. Use '[system]' to refer system assigned identity, or a resource id to refer user assigned identity. Check out help for more examples.

parameters.name: --basic-auth
parameters.help: Enable or disable basic auth for both SCM and FTP Basic Auth Publishing Credentials. Disabled by default for new apps. See https://aka.ms/app-service-basic-auth to learn more.

parameters.name: --container-image-name
parameters.help: The container custom image name and optionally the tag name (e.g., `<registry- name>/<image-name>:<tag>`). Note: if --container-registry-url is also provided, use `<image-name>:<tag>` without the registry name.

parameters.name: --container-registry-password
parameters.help: The container registry server password. Required for private registries.

parameters.name: --container-registry-url
parameters.help: The container registry server url.

parameters.name: --container-registry-user
parameters.help: The container registry server username.

parameters.name: --deployment-container-image-name
parameters.help: Container image name from container registry, e.g. publisher/image-name:tag. WARNING: Option '--deployment-container-image-name' has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release.

parameters.name: --deployment-local-git
parameters.help: Enable local git.

parameters.name: --deployment-source-branch
parameters.help: The branch to deploy.

parameters.name: --deployment-source-url
parameters.help: Git repository URL to link with manual integration.

parameters.name: --docker-registry-server-password
parameters.help: The container registry server password. Required for private registries. WARNING: Option '--docker-registry-server-password' has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Use '--container-registry-password' instead.

parameters.name: --docker-registry-server-user
parameters.help: The container registry server username. WARNING: Option '--docker-registry-server-user' has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Use '--container-registry-user' instead.

parameters.name: --domain-name-scope
parameters.help: Specify the scope of uniqueness for the default hostname during resource creation.

parameters.name: --end-to-end-encryption-enabled
parameters.help: Enable or disable end-to-end encryption between the Front End and the Workers.

parameters.name: --https-only
parameters.help: Redirect all traffic made to an app using HTTP to HTTPS.

parameters.name: --min-tls-cipher-suite
parameters.help: The minimum TLS Cipher Suite required for requests, e.g., 'TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384'.

parameters.name: --min-tls-version
parameters.help: The minimum version of TLS required for SSL requests, e.g., '1.0', '1.1', '1.2'.

parameters.name: --multicontainer-config-file
parameters.help: Linux only. Config file for multicontainer apps. (local or remote).

parameters.name: --multicontainer-config-type
parameters.help: Linux only.

parameters.name: --public-network-access
parameters.help: Enable or disable public access to the web app.

parameters.name: --role
parameters.help: Role name or id the system assigned identity will have.

parameters.name: --runtime
parameters.help: Canonicalized web runtime in the format of Framework:Version, e.g. "PYTHON:3.14".Use `az webapp list-runtimes` for available list.

parameters.name: --scope
parameters.help: Scope that the system assigned identity can access.

parameters.name: --site-scoped-certs
parameters.help: Enable or disable site-scoped certificates.

parameters.name: --sitecontainers-app
parameters.help: If true, a webapp which supports sitecontainers will be created.

parameters.name: --startup-file
parameters.help: Linux only. The web's startup command or script file. Required for FastAPI and other ASGI frameworks (auto-detection is not supported). Example command: "gunicorn --bind=0.0.0.0 --timeout 600 app:app". Example for FastAPI: "gunicorn -k uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker app:app". Example script file: "startup.sh".

parameters.name: --subnet
parameters.help: Name or resource ID of the pre-existing subnet to have the webapp join. The --vnet is argument also needed if specifying subnet by name.

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.help: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value]...]. Use '' to clear existing tags.

parameters.name: --vnet
parameters.help: Name or resource ID of the regional virtual network. If there are multiple vnets of the same name across different resource groups, use vnet resource id to specify which vnet to use. If vnet name is used, by default, the vnet in the same resource group as the webapp will be used. Must be used with --subnet argument.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
